text:
emily_support: heads up — multiple hosted customers reporting intermittent 502/503 starting ~2026-06-15T15:05Z. they see about ~18% failures for a 10m window. attached curl and gateway body.

ops-bot: alert: CRITICAL: api.gateway.5xx surge (15m)

emily_support: example request: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rw_open_v1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
response: 503 Service Unavailable
body: {"error":"control_plane: dependency_unavailable","code":503}

ryan_api: digging into traces. gateway is getting 502/503 from control-plane routing-eval. routing-eval logs show repeated timeouts calling config-db and auth-session-store around 15:03:10 - 15:08:40.

ryan_api: log excerpt:
```
[WARN] 2026-06-15T15:04:12Z routing-eval request=94cf upstream=config-db error=connect ETIMEDOUT
[ERROR] 2026-06-15T15:04:12Z routing-eval request=94cf evaluator=main returning=502 reason=policy-lookup-failed
[INFO] 2026-06-15T15:04:13Z gateway req=94cf upstream=routing-eval status=502
```

kevin_oncall: any recent infra churn? deploys? config changes?

maria_platform: yes we rolled a change to the config-db client pooler at 15:00 to reduce idle connections (client:v2.3.0). prometheus shows a sharp jump in new TCP connections and listeners hitting fd soft-limit on the client side shortly after.

lina_sre: saw increased iowait and syscalls on the config-db replicas; disk busy and higher read latencies. that plus client churn likely causing timeouts.

evan: (bot) automated rollback check: no auto-rollback triggered for client:v2.3.0

kevin_oncall: quick mitigation plan: 1) rollback client to v2.2.9 2) temporarily increase routing-eval timeout and retries 3) enable gateway cached routing-policy fallback for hosts with repeated failures 4) scale config-db read replicas and increase fd/ulimit on pods

maria_platform: initiating rollback to client:v2.2.9 now.

lina_sre: scaling config-db-read to 5 replicas and raising pod ulimit:
```bash
kubectl scale deploy/config-db-read -n controlplane --replicas=5
kubectl set resources deploy/config-db-read -n controlplane --limits=cpu=2 --requests=500m
kubectl exec -n controlplane config-db-read-0 -- bash -c "ulimit -n 200000"
```

ryan_api: bumping routing-eval timeout from 300ms to 1200ms and retries 2->4. applying env change now.

ops-bot: mitigation actions started by @maria_platform @kevin_oncall @ryan_api

emily_support: customers report error rates dropping within ~4-6 minutes after rollback and scaling. monitoring shows 5xx falling back to baseline by 15:12Z.

maria_platform: preliminary root cause: conn-pool tuning in client:v2.3.0 created aggressive short-lived connections under typical workload, exhausting ephemeral ports and creating a spike of connection churn; config-db read latency increased, hitting client timeouts and propagating 502s through routing-eval to the gateway.

lina_sre: follow-ups: 1) revert client change from canary only until performance vetted 2) add FD, tcp_close_queue, and ephemeral port metrics to control-plane dashboards 3) implement slow-start connection ramping in pooler 4) add a cached/default routing-policy in gateway for brief control-plane outages to avoid user-facing 5xx

kevin_oncall: customer-facing status message draft: "We saw elevated 5xx errors caused by a control-plane dependency (config DB) experiencing increased latency due to a client connection-pool regression. We rolled back the change and scaled the read pool; errors returned to normal by 15:12 UTC. We'll follow up with a full postmortem." comments?

emily_support: looks good 1: please include impacted tenants list and SLO hit calc.

ryan_api: repro steps for eng team:
1) deploy client:v2.3.0 to staging routing-eval with traffic generator set to 200rps
2) monitor `/proc/net/tcp`, `ss -s`, and open fd counts on routing-eval and config-db pods
3) induce artificial config-db latency via iptables tc or a proxy shim:
```bash
# add 300ms latency to config-db service
kubectl exec -n controlplane -it debug-proxy -- tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 300ms
```
4) compare behavior between client:v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 and capture tcpdump + heap profiles

lina_sre: preserve artifacts: control-plane traces, tcpdumps, fd snapshots, k8s events. add ticket INF-5299 for follow-up.

maria_platform: created INF-5299 and assigned to infra-team. will schedule canary and load test before next roll.

emily_support: customers asking about credits 1: ops-bot can you pull SLO breach numbers for 15:00-15:20Z and impacted tenant list?

ops-bot: generated report (link) 1: impacted tenants: shopmate, acme, clearfin. peak 5xx rate 18.7% between 15:05-15:10Z.

kevin_oncall: tagging: @lina_sre to own postmortem writeup, @maria_platform to own client fix and canary gating, @ryan_api to update routing-eval circuit-breaking/backoff defaults.

emily_support: i'll escalate to accounts and send status notes. closing interim incident once 5xx < 1% for 30m.

lina_sre: drafting postmortem. ETA EOD tomorrow. will include timeline, metrics, mitigations, and suggested customer credits.

emily_support: great work all. will update thread with customer replies. (END)
